clipper.title: Clipper
clipper.subtitle: Upload one of your long videos and get vertical shorts with captions. AI proposes the moments; you choose.

youtube.title: From a YouTube link
youtube.body: YouTube's official API doesn't allow downloading videos, so we won't. Download your video from YouTube Studio and upload it here.

empty.title: Upload your first long video
empty.body: Podcast, livestream, tutorial or talk. We transcribe the audio, AI proposes the best moments and you generate the shorts you pick.

upload.title: New video
upload.body: MP4 up to 50 MB and 60 min (current storage limit). If it's bigger, export it at 720p.
upload.rights: I confirm this is my own content or that I have the rights to edit and publish it.
upload.rightsHint: Don't upload other creators' videos, TV broadcasts or third-party copyrighted music: platforms may remove the clips and penalise your account.
upload.costHint: Pick a video to see the cost.

clipper.deleteConfirm: Delete this analysis? The original video and generated shorts stay in the library.

progress.transcribing: Transcribing the audio… usually 1–5 minutes. You can close the page: we keep going in the background.
progress.analyzing: AI is picking the best moments…

clipper.noMoments: We couldn't find clear moments in this video. Try one with more dialogue.
clipper.momentsHint: Moments proposed by AI, ranked by virality score (relative potential within this video). Tick the ones you want to generate, schedule or download.
clipper.renderHint: Each clip is cut from the original, adapted to the chosen format and saved to the library ready to schedule. No watermark.
clipper.render: {n, plural, =0 {Generate shorts} one {Generate # short} other {Generate # shorts}}
clipper.previewMoment: Preview of the moment in the original video
clipper.renderFailed: This short couldn't be generated. Your credits were refunded; you can try again.

errors.only_mp4: MP4 only for now (it's the format transcription supports). Export it as MP4 (H.264).
errors.too_big: The video is larger than 50 MB. Export it at 720p or trim it.
errors.too_long: The video is longer than 60 minutes.
errors.too_short: The video is too short to clip (min 20 s).
errors.no_duration: We couldn't read the video's length. Try exporting it again as MP4.
errors.upload_failed: The video couldn't be uploaded. Check your connection.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this in this project.
errors.provider_error: The video service isn't available. Your credits were refunded.
errors.no_speech: We didn't detect speech in the video.
errors.duration_mismatch: The video's real length doesn't match the one read at upload.
errors.analysis_failed: The AI couldn't analyse the transcript.
errors.bad_range: Each clip must last 10–90 seconds and be within the video.
errors.busy: Wait for the current process to finish.
errors.download_failed: Some clip couldn't be downloaded. Try again.
errors.no_slots: No free slots in the next 21 days for those accounts (daily limit reached).
errors.invalid_accounts: Some account isn't active or doesn't belong to this project.
errors.refusal: The AI couldn't write the copy. Your credits were refunded.

clipper.selectToRender: Tick proposed (or failed) moments to generate them with this style.
clipper.cropHint: The dashed frame is what's kept when cropping to {format}. If the speaker falls outside, choose “Fit”.
clipper.rerenderHint: Uses the format and style chosen in “Format and captions”. The previous clip stays in the library. If it fails, your credits are refunded.

virality.noBreakdown: This moment was analysed before the breakdown existed: it only has the total score.
virality.disclaimer: Relative potential within this video (hook 35%, value 30%, pacing 20%, trend 15%). “Trend” is the fit with formats that usually work, without real-time data. It is not a view prediction.

layoutHint.crop: Fills the screen by cropping the sides around the centre. Best if you're centred.
layoutHint.fit: Shows the whole video with coloured bars. Use it for two people or if you're off to one side.

options.subtitlesHint: Automatic transcription of the audio with the chosen template. If you turn them off, download the .srt and upload it as captions on the platform.

styleHint.karaoke: 3-word blocks; the spoken word is highlighted in your accent colour.
styleHint.box: 2-word phrases on a box in your colour (the box covers the phrase, not just the active word).
styleHint.caps: Big capitals in Bebas Neue with the active word highlighted.
styleHint.minimal: Full sentence, light and without animation.
styleHint.word: A single big word in your colour, with a bounce.

options.accentHint: Your brand kit colours are converted to the closest colour the caption engine supports.
options.previewHint: Style simulation. The real result animates each block's entrance.

scheduler.title: Schedule clips
scheduler.intro: Kreo spreads the ticked clips over the next free slots in your calendar (respecting each account's daily limit) and writes each network's copy in your brand voice.
scheduler.selectDone: Tick one or more generated clips to schedule them.
scheduler.noneDone: Generate a clip first to be able to schedule it.
scheduler.noAccounts: There are no connected accounts in this project.
scheduler.perDayHint: No account's daily limit is ever exceeded. Starts tomorrow, Madrid time.
scheduler.proposalHint: Dates are a proposal: you can change them in the calendar before approving.
scheduler.unscheduled: {n, plural, one {# clip doesn't fit in the next 21 days.} other {# clips don't fit in the next 21 days.}}
scheduler.submitHint: Only if it meets each network's rules. TikTok needs you to choose privacy by hand, so it stays as a draft. Approval is always yours.
scheduler.done: {n, plural, one {# draft created in the calendar.} other {# drafts created in the calendar.}}
scheduler.legal: Kreo never publishes on its own: it creates drafts (or pending approvals) that you review and approve.
